# AI Consulting Services

> A strategy workshop, a data foundation and a working pilot are three different purchases. Start with the deliverable you need to accept.

Published by AY Automate.

## Guide
- [Which AI consulting service do you need?](https://topaiconsultingservices.com/)
- [Write a brief for a paid AI pilot](https://topaiconsultingservices.com/worksheet/)

## Provider sources
- [AY Automate](https://www.ayautomate.com/case-studies): Workflow implementation. Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Ask who owns each integration after handover.
- [BCG](https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/artificial-intelligence): Enterprise transformation. Combines strategy and applied AI. Ask which operating decisions the first engagement would change.
- [IBM Consulting](https://www.ibm.com/consulting/artificial-intelligence): Technology integration. Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Ask for a design showing how existing applications and data will connect.
- [Slalom](https://www.slalom.com/us/en/services/artificial-intelligence): AI implementation. Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Ask who will build alongside your engineers and support the first release.
- [McKinsey QuantumBlack](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-approach): Analytics and operating model. Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Bring a decision that already has an accountable business owner.
- [Accenture](https://www.accenture.com/en-us/support/state-texas-accenture-dir-artificial-intelligence): Enterprise delivery. Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Check the scope and purchasing terms applicable to your organization.
- [Deloitte](https://www.deloitte.com/global/en/services/consulting/services/engineering-ai-data.html): Engineering and data. Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Ask how platform work and application delivery would be costed separately.
- [Capgemini](https://www.capgemini.com/news/client-stories/zf-friedrichshafen-establishes-a-global-rpa-service-in-a-single-year/): Process automation. Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Ask how the team handles process exceptions.
- [WeAreBrain](https://wearebrain.com/ai-automation-agency/): Workflow integration. Offers workflow automation and integration. Bring a process that crosses two systems and ask how failed writes are reconciled.
- [Goodspeed](https://goodspeed.studio/n8n-agency): Operations workflows. Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. Ask for an example of a workflow your own team could maintain.
- [Remote MCP](https://topaiconsultingservices.com/mcp): search_firms, compare_firms and recommend_providers.
